stem.en: A beam balance hangs level with one coin in each cup, both cups at the same distance from the middle. A second coin is added to the right cup, and the beam tips. Without adding or removing coins, how can it balance again?

text.en: Move the right cup to half its distance from the middle.
Move the right cup to twice its distance from the middle.
Move the left cup to half its distance from the middle.
Move both cups further out by the same amount.

explanation.en: Coins x distance must be equal on both sides. On the left: 1 coin x d. On the right: 2 coins. So the right cup must be at d/2: 2 x d/2 = 1 x d. Moving the right cup further out, or the left cup in, makes the tip worse.

hints.en: Number of coins x distance must match on both sides.
Two coins need how much distance to match one coin at distance d?
